title: Orchestrator
bootingBody: His screen fills in as soon as his terminal is up.
absentBody: His terminal is closed. Restart the app, or check his engine in Settings, to bring {{godName}} back.
saveFailed: That change did not save. Try again.

strip.spendTip: Today's spend from the cost ledger. Open Budget and breaker to set a daily cap.
strip.breakerTip: The circuit breaker stops a runaway loop. Open Budget and breaker for each agent's state.
strip.tasksTip: Cards in progress. Open the board.
strip.waitingTip: Questions and requests waiting on your answer. Open them in the Inbox.

deliveries.pauseTip: Hold every agent's queue so the floor stops and listens. Nothing is lost; queued messages wait.
deliveries.resumeTip: Let every agent's queue deliver again.
deliveries.bannerBody: Every agent's queue is held. Messages wait until you resume; Send now and Steer still go through.
deliveries.bannerBudgetBody: Today's spend is {{spend}} of your {{cap}} cap, so every agent's queue is held.
deliveries.failed: Could not change deliveries. Try again.

terminal.inFocus: His terminal is in focus mode
terminal.inFocusBody: {{godName}}'s terminal is open full screen. Leave focus mode to see it here.
terminal.noneBody: It closed or has not started yet. It appears here as soon as it is up.

messages.windowNote: His latest {{n}} messages. The Routing tab has the full log.
messages.emptyBody: What {{godName}} sends and receives shows up here.
messages.steerTip: Send what is in the box below so it lands on his next turn, instead of waiting in the queue.
messages.steerHint: Send queues your message until {{godName}} is free. Steer lands it on his next turn.
messages.steered: Steered. {{godName}} gets it on his next turn.

routing.truncated: Older entries are past the part of the log that is read.
routing.emptyBody: Every message the floor sends, who sent it to whom and when, lands here.
routing.noHive: Open a floor to see its routing log.
routing.error: Could not read the routing log

budget.noHive: Open a floor to see what it spends.
budget.capHint: When today's spend reaches the cap, deliveries pause and you get a notification. Leave it empty for no cap.
budget.capInvalid: Type an amount in dollars, like 10 or 12.50.
budget.capBelowSpend: Today's spend is already past this. Saving it pauses deliveries now.
budget.barsAria: Spend per day for the last seven days
budget.source: Counted from the cost ledger, which takes Claude Code's own cost and estimates the other engines from their tokens. Local days, midnight to midnight.
budget.defaultCapHint: The breaker applies it to every agent without a cap of its own. It counts work tokens: input, output and cache writes.
budget.workTokensTip: Work tokens this session, and the cap that applies
budget.noWorkers: No agents on the floor yet.
budget.breakerIntro: The breaker watches for a runaway loop: the same tool call over and over, a storm of errors, tokens with no progress, or an agent past its cap. It steers first, then holds the agent to planning.
budget.limits: Trips on {{repeat}} identical tool calls, {{errors}} errors in a row, or {{velocity}} output tokens a minute.
budget.hardStopHint: When on, an agent that keeps tripping has its terminal stopped. Its work on disk stays.

config.engineHintKeep: A new model on the same engine keeps his conversation.
config.engineHintFresh: A new engine starts a fresh conversation.
config.continueTip: Restart his terminal on the same engine and model and pick the conversation back up. Fixes a garbled screen.
config.confirmEngine: Restart {{godName}} on {{engine}}? His current conversation does not carry over to a new engine.

err.noTerminal: He has no terminal to restart.
err.crossProvider: A conversation cannot move to a different engine.
err.noSession: No session is recorded for him yet, so there is nothing to continue. His terminal was left running.
err.noTranscript: His session transcript was not found, so it cannot continue. His terminal was left running.
err.spawnFailed: The new terminal did not start.
err.resumeRefused: The engine refused to continue the session.

config.roleHint: His job in one line. It is what the floor and his roster call him.
config.roleFailed: Saved here, but the hive did not take the change.
config.briefPlaceholder: What {{godName}} should always keep in mind: priorities, house rules, who to ask.
config.briefHint: He reads it at the start of every session and whenever it changes. Saves when you leave the field.
config.autoModeOff: New agents ask before they act
config.autoModeHint: Applies to agents started from now on.
config.maySpawnHintOn: {{godName}} can hire on his own. Every agent he starts spends tokens you did not approve.
config.maySpawnHintOff: {{godName}} can still ask, and his request waits in the queue instead of failing.
